questions.question: Which earlier WHO Technical Report Series annex does the revised GMP main principles document in Annex 2 of TRS 986 replace?
questions.answer: It revises the GMP main principles published in WHO Technical Report Series, No. 961, 2011, Annex 3.

questions.question: In the WHO GMP glossary (TRS 986 Annex 2), what is a starting material and what does it exclude?
questions.answer: A starting material is any substance of a defined quality used in producing a pharmaceutical product, excluding packaging materials.

questions.question: Under the WHO GMP guidance on product recalls, where should recalled products be kept while a decision is made on what to do with them?
questions.answer: Recalled products should be stored in a secure segregated area while their fate is decided, and the written recall procedures should include this instruction.

questions.question: What kind of additional medical check does WHO GMP guidance require for personnel who carry out visual inspections of products?
questions.answer: Personnel conducting visual inspections should undergo periodic eye examinations, in addition to the health examinations required before and during employment.

questions.question: In the WHO TRS 986 Annex 2 GMP documentation section, how should an alteration to an entry on a document be made so the original information stays readable?
questions.answer: Any alteration should be signed and dated and done so the original information can still be read, with the reason recorded where appropriate (clause 15.7).

questions.question: Under WHO TRS 986 Annex 2 good production practices, which kinds of products are named as needing dedicated and self-contained production areas to avoid cross-contamination?
questions.must_contain: penicillins, live vaccines, live bacterial preparations
questions.answer: Dedicated, self-contained areas may be required for products such as penicillins, live vaccines, live bacterial preparations and certain other biologicals.

questions.question: On which page of WHO TRS 986 Annex 2 does the subsection on reference standards under Materials begin?
questions.answer: The Reference standards subsection under Section 14 Materials begins on page 114.

questions.question: In WHO TRS 986 Annex 2, what term is used for the totality of systematic actions that give adequate confidence a product will meet quality requirements?
questions.answer: The totality of these systematic actions is termed quality assurance (QA), which serves as a management tool within an organization.

questions.question: Under the WHO TRS 986 Annex 2 guidance on contract production, who must give final release approval when the outsourced work is analysis?
questions.answer: For contract analysis, the authorized person must give final approval for release in accordance with GMP and the marketing authorization as specified in the contract (7.4).

questions.question: Under the WHO TRS 986 Annex 2 premises requirements, what must be in place regarding pests and rodents in a manufacturing facility?
questions.must_contain: procedure for rodent and pest control
questions.answer: Premises should be designed to protect against entry of insects, birds or other animals, and there should be a procedure for rodent and pest control (clause 12.9).

questions.question: Under WHO TRS 986 Annex 2 GMP documentation rules, how long must manufacturing records be kept relative to the finished product's expiry date?
questions.answer: Records should be retained for at least one year after the expiry date of the finished product.

questions.question: Under WHO TRS 986 Annex 2 good production practices, what information must be shown on the label attached to a measuring or control instrument?
questions.answer: The label must clearly show the date of calibration and servicing and the date when recalibration is due.
